voltage-magenta.$description: Voltage Magenta — Filled buttons, link borders, brand accents — the single saturated current that makes the otherwise quiet page feel switched on

plasma-gradient.$description: Plasma Gradient — Logo fill, decorative gradient washes — the spectrum from deep purple to hot pink that anchors brand identity

ember-orange.$description: Ember Orange — NEW badges, lightning-bolt icons, warm accent punctuation — used sparingly as energy, not as a second brand

signal-red.$description: Signal Red — Red wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, all borders and dividers, dark button surface, icon strokes — the structural neutral that carries 800+ usages

porcelain.$description: Porcelain — Page background, feature card surfaces, phone-mockup panels — the off-white that lets white cards lift off the canvas

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Neutral form states, badge text, and quiet UI feedback where color should stay understated. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

graphite.$description: Graphite — Dark filled-button variant, high-contrast surfaces, secondary button backgrounds

stone.$description: Stone — Body text, icon strokes, supporting metadata — the readable gray for non-headline copy

mist.$description: Mist — Light borders, link underlines, disabled dividers, subtle separators

roobert.$description: All UI text — headlines at 700/56px, section headings at 700/40px, body at 400/16px, caption labels at 500/12px tracked out
